data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and in future months at full stock. If all 25 follow it, total catch is 250 tons, leaving 250; either replenishment outcome then restores 500. That yields each of us $10,000 every month without risking collapse. Let's preserve this reliable income rather than race for a one-time catch. I intend to request 10 tons and ask everyone to do likewise.
